### Headline summary
- Nvidia's board has launched an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang following reports of a foreign intelligence affair. ([TechSpot](https://www.techspot.com/news/114483-us-officials-chinese-businesswoman-close-nvidia-jensen-huang.html), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-08/nvidia-board-to-probe-spying-case-after-ceo-jensen-huang-admits-infidelity))
- AI companies have raised over $300 billion in stock sales in 2026, with approximately $100 billion more on tap. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/ai-stock-can-market-absorb), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261108/p10#a261108p10))
- Apple CEO John Ternus is pressuring software chief Craig Federighi to accelerate the company's AI efforts beyond Siri tweaks. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2026-11-08/apple-explores-turning-siri-ai-into-chatgpt-dots-like-agent-ios-28-shake-up), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261108/p9#a261108p9))

### Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang
Nvidia's board of directors has launched an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang following reports of a foreign intelligence affair and potential spying. ([TechSpot](https://www.techspot.com/news/114483-us-officials-chinese-businesswoman-close-nvidia-jensen-huang.html), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-08/nvidia-board-to-probe-spying-case-after-ceo-jensen-huang-admits-infidelity), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/08/technology/nvidia-investigation-jensen-huang-china.html), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/nvidia-jensen-huang-investigation-chinese-spy-2026-11))

### AI companies raise over $300 billion in stock sales in 2026
Excluding Anthropic's IPO, AI companies have sold or priced over $300 billion in stock in 2026, with approximately $100 billion more on tap, raising questions about market absorption capacity. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/ai-stock-can-market-absorb), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261108/p10#a261108p10))

### Apple CEO pushes for more ambitious AI strategy
Apple CEO John Ternus is pressuring software chief Craig Federighi to accelerate the company's AI efforts, moving beyond Siri tweaks to more agentic and advanced capabilities. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2026-11-08/apple-explores-turning-siri-ai-into-chatgpt-dots-like-agent-ios-28-shake-up), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261108/p9#a261108p9), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1029552/apple-siri-ai-agentic))

### Anthropic purchases $3.4 billion in gas-fired generators for data centers
Anthropic has agreed to a $3.4 billion deal to buy commitments for 1.7GW of gas-fired generators from OnePWR, the largest known such purchase by an AI lab, to power its data centers. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-08/anthropic-buys-power-for-ai-data-centres-in-3-4b-deal-ft-says), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261108/p8#a261108p8))

### DeepSeek Harness agent app reaches 1.54 million daily users
DeepSeek announced that its open-source agent app, Harness, has reached 1.54 million daily active users less than three months after launch, processing approximately 92 trillion tokens per day. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-08/deepseek-s-ai-agent-platform-hits-1-54-million-daily-users), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261108/p12#a261108p12))

### US midterm elections impact AI and data center politics
The 2026 US midterm election results saw the AI safety super PAC Public First win seats, while voters expressed opposition to the AI data center boom, prompting a shift in political stance against the industry. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261107/p17#a261107p17), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261107/p18#a261107p18), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/08/us-midterms-ai-datacentres-broligarchy-voter-backlash), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-08/voters-put-the-ai-data-center-boom-on-notice-video))

### UK government continues AI data center expansion despite backlash
UK officials have stated that data center construction will continue as essential infrastructure, with the growth minister backing expansion despite growing international and domestic backlash against the technology. ([International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/uk-expand-data-centers-ai-opposition-3809536), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2310304/uk-has-no-plans-to-slow-down-ai-data-center-construction/))

### Suno AI sued for copyright infringement by Elvis and Eminem rights holders
Groups holding the music rights to Elvis Presley and Eminem have filed new lawsuits against the AI music generator Suno for copyright infringement. ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1029533/elvis-eminem-suno-ai-music-clone-lawsuit), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2310316/suno-ai-music-generator-sued-again-for-copyright-infringement/))
